replacements.old: - [ ] Character lexical recall ([MH03](../limits/memory.md#mh03)) still matches through the database parser, which under a C-locale database glues non-ASCII punctuation to words and does not lowercase non-ASCII letters, so model recall can miss such words. Found 2026-09-29 during the player-history search review; [PW09](next-playable-week.md#pw09--correct-and-efficient-memory-retrieval) now proposes the shared normalizer plus parser-independent lexical serialization, with ranking/privacy qualification. The bug remains open until those checks pass.
replacements.new: Character lexical recall now uses the shared Unicode normalizer and parser-independent lexical serialization. [PW09](next-playable-week.md#pw09--correct-and-efficient-memory-retrieval) and [its recorded PostgreSQL evidence](../verification/data-foundation.md#pw09--unicode-and-scoped-retrieval) supersede the old C-locale parser bug. Larger exact-vector cost, failed 100k-source restores and broader quality/capacity acceptance remain with their focused owners; fixing lexical correctness does not close those gates.
